At twenty to four we were at the river in Takijiri, a quarter of an hour later on the trail. The first hour does not pretend: steps, roots, then more steps.

朝は雲の上で始まり、紙の提灯の門で終わった。その間に、濡れても滑りにくい石畳、杉林の沢、そしてカメラの前でじっとしていた鮮やかな橙色のカニ。

The bird in the logo is the Yatagarasu, messenger of the Kumano deities. According to the old chronicles it guided Emperor Jimmu through the mountains from Kumano to Yamato. Its three legs are often read as heaven, earth and humankind. On the trail you meet it on shrine banners and on the goōhōin talismans, and on the middle lantern of the gate in Chikatsuyu.

Der Vogel im Logo ist die Yatagarasu, Botin der Kumano-Gottheiten. Den alten Chroniken nach führte sie Kaiser Jimmu durch die Berge von Kumano nach Yamato. Ihre drei Beine werden oft als Himmel, Erde und Mensch gedeutet. Am Weg begegnet man ihr auf Schreinfahnen, den Goōhōin-Amuletten und auf der mittleren Laterne des Tors in Chikatsuyu.

ロゴの鳥は八咫烏、熊野の神々の使いです。古い記録によれば、神武天皇を熊野から大和へと山中で導いたとされます。三本の足は天・地・人を表すとよく言われます。道中では神社の幟や熊野牛王宝印の護符に、そして近露の門の真ん中の提灯にも姿を見せます。

Do I need to book accommodation in advance?
Yes, and early. Takahara and Chikatsuyu each have a handful of minshuku, and in spring and autumn they are full months ahead. The Tanabe tourism office reservation service books in English.

{"answer":"Yes, and early. Takahara and Chikatsuyu each have a handful of minshuku, and in spring and autumn they are full months ahead. The Tanabe tourism office reservation service books in English.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"1","question":"Do I need to book accommodation in advance?"}
Muss ich die Unterkünfte im Voraus buchen?
Ja, und früh. Takahara und Chikatsuyu haben je eine Handvoll Minshuku, und im Frühling und Herbst sind sie Monate vorher voll. Der Reservierungsdienst des Tourismusbüros in Tanabe bucht auf Englisch.

{"answer":"Yes, and early. Takahara and Chikatsuyu each have a handful of minshuku, and in spring and autumn they are full months ahead. The Tanabe tourism office reservation service books in English.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"1","question":"Do I need to book accommodation in advance?"}
宿は事前に予約が必要ですか？
はい、早めに。高原と近露には民宿が数軒ずつしかなく、春と秋は数か月前に満室になります。田辺市観光協会の予約サービスは英語でも対応しています。

{"answer":"The Kii peninsula is one of the wettest regions of Japan. Waterproof boots and gaiters help less than you hope; a dry change of clothes in a sealed bag helps more.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"How much rain should I expect?"}
雨はどのくらい降りますか？
紀伊半島は日本でも特に雨の多い地域です。防水の靴やスパッツは思ったほど役に立たず、密封袋に入れた乾いた着替えのほうが助かります。

{"answer":"Yes. Buses link the villages along the route several times a day, which makes it easy to shorten a day or to get back to the start.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"Can you get around by bus?"}
バスで移動できますか？
はい。ルート沿いの集落を一日に何本かバスが結んでいるので、一日を短くしたり出発地へ戻ったりしやすいです。

{"answer":"Yes, between the main villages, booked through the Tanabe tourism office one day ahead.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"Is there a luggage transfer?"}
荷物の配送はありますか？
はい、主な集落の間で利用でき、前日までに田辺市観光協会で予約します。

{"answer":"The Kii peninsula is one of the wettest regions of Japan. Waterproof boots and gaiters help less than you hope; a dry change of clothes in a sealed bag helps more.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"How much rain should I expect?"}
Mit wie viel Regen muss man rechnen?
Die Kii-Halbinsel gehört zu den regenreichsten Gegenden Japans. Wasserdichte Schuhe und Gamaschen helfen weniger als erhofft; trockene Wechselkleidung in einem dichten Beutel hilft mehr.

{"answer":"Yes. Buses link the villages along the route several times a day, which makes it easy to shorten a day or to get back to the start.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"Can you get around by bus?"}
Kommt man mit dem Bus voran?
Ja. Busse verbinden die Orte entlang der Route mehrmals am Tag. So lässt sich ein Tag verkürzen oder man kommt zum Start zurück.

{"answer":"Yes, between the main villages, booked through the Tanabe tourism office one day ahead.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"Is there a luggage transfer?"}
Ja, zwischen den größeren Orten, einen Tag vorher über das Tourismusbüro in Tanabe gebucht.
How much rain should I expect?
The Kii peninsula is one of the wettest regions of Japan. Waterproof boots and gaiters help less than you hope; a dry change of clothes in a sealed bag helps more.
Can you get around by bus?
Yes. Buses link the villages along the route several times a day, which makes it easy to shorten a day or to get back to the start.
Yes, between the main villages, booked through the Tanabe tourism office one day ahead.
The order of the stations and the day boundaries are right, the geometry is not. For navigation you need the tourism office map.

杉の霧のなかを 歩いた四日間
紀伊半島 · 和歌山 · 2024年4月
熊野古道は一本の長距離トレイルではなく、三つの神社へ向かう古い参詣道の網です。4月、滝尻から那智まで、四日間で中辺路を歩きました。

Between Takijiri and Hongu the trail crosses passes barely higher than 700 metres, and still it feels remote. The forests are planted sugi cedars, set close together; when the mist settles between them you cannot see twenty metres ahead.

Along the way you pass the oji, small roadside shrines where pilgrims once stopped to pray. Most are a clearing, a stone and a wooden torii, easy to walk past if you are looking at your feet.

Zwischen Takijiri und Hongu quert der Weg Pässe, die kaum höher als 700 Meter sind, und trotzdem wirkt er abgelegen. Die Wälder sind gepflanzte Sugi-Zedern, dicht an dicht; wenn sich Nebel zwischen sie legt, sieht man keine zwanzig Meter weit.

Unterwegs kommt man an den Oji vorbei, kleinen Schreinen am Weg, an denen Pilger früher beteten. Meist sind es eine Lichtung, ein Stein und ein hölzernes Torii, leicht zu übersehen, wenn man auf die Füße schaut.

滝尻から本宮まで、道は標高700メートルにも満たない峠を越えていくのに、どこか人里離れた感じがする。森は植林された杉が密に並び、霧が立ち込めると二十メートル先も見えない。

道中では王子を通り過ぎる。かつて参詣者が祈った道端の小さな社だ。たいていは空き地と石と木の鳥居だけで、足元ばかり見ていると見落としてしまう。

The bird in the logo is the Yatagarasu, messenger of the Kumano deities. According to the old chronicles it guided Emperor Jimmu through the mountains from Kumano to Yamato. Its three legs are often read as heaven, earth and humankind. On the trail you meet it on shrine banners and on the goōhōin talismans, and on the middle lantern of the gate in Chikatsuyu.

Der Vogel im Logo ist die Yatagarasu, Botin der Kumano-Gottheiten. Den alten Chroniken nach führte sie Kaiser Jimmu durch die Berge von Kumano nach Yamato. Ihre drei Beine werden oft als Himmel, Erde und Mensch gedeutet. Am Weg begegnet man ihr auf Schreinfahnen, den Goōhōin-Amuletten und auf der mittleren Laterne des Tors in Chikatsuyu.

ロゴの鳥は八咫烏、熊野の神々の使いです。古い記録によれば、神武天皇を熊野から大和へと山中で導いたとされます。三本の足は天・地・人を表すとよく言われます。道中では神社の幟や熊野牛王宝印の護符に、そして近露の門の真ん中の提灯にも姿を見せます。

Do I need to book accommodation in advance?
Yes, and early. Takahara and Chikatsuyu each have a handful of minshuku, and in spring and autumn they are full months ahead. The Tanabe tourism office reservation service books in English.

{"answer":"Yes, and early. Takahara and Chikatsuyu each have a handful of minshuku, and in spring and autumn they are full months ahead. The Tanabe tourism office reservation service books in English.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"1","question":"Do I need to book accommodation in advance?"}
Muss ich die Unterkünfte im Voraus buchen?
Ja, und früh. Takahara und Chikatsuyu haben je eine Handvoll Minshuku, und im Frühling und Herbst sind sie Monate vorher voll. Der Reservierungsdienst des Tourismusbüros in Tanabe bucht auf Englisch.

{"answer":"Yes, and early. Takahara and Chikatsuyu each have a handful of minshuku, and in spring and autumn they are full months ahead. The Tanabe tourism office reservation service books in English.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"1","question":"Do I need to book accommodation in advance?"}
宿は事前に予約が必要ですか？
はい、早めに。高原と近露には民宿が数軒ずつしかなく、春と秋は数か月前に満室になります。田辺市観光協会の予約サービスは英語でも対応しています。

{"answer":"The Kii peninsula is one of the wettest regions of Japan. Waterproof boots and gaiters help less than you hope; a dry change of clothes in a sealed bag helps more.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"How much rain should I expect?"}
雨はどのくらい降りますか？
紀伊半島は日本でも特に雨の多い地域です。防水の靴やスパッツは思ったほど役に立たず、密封袋に入れた乾いた着替えのほうが助かります。

{"answer":"Yes. Buses link the villages along the route several times a day, which makes it easy to shorten a day or to get back to the start.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"Can you get around by bus?"}
バスで移動できますか？
はい。ルート沿いの集落を一日に何本かバスが結んでいるので、一日を短くしたり出発地へ戻ったりしやすいです。

{"answer":"Yes, between the main villages, booked through the Tanabe tourism office one day ahead.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"Is there a luggage transfer?"}
荷物の配送はありますか？
はい、主な集落の間で利用でき、前日までに田辺市観光協会で予約します。

{"answer":"The Kii peninsula is one of the wettest regions of Japan. Waterproof boots and gaiters help less than you hope; a dry change of clothes in a sealed bag helps more.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"How much rain should I expect?"}
Mit wie viel Regen muss man rechnen?
Die Kii-Halbinsel gehört zu den regenreichsten Gegenden Japans. Wasserdichte Schuhe und Gamaschen helfen weniger als erhofft; trockene Wechselkleidung in einem dichten Beutel hilft mehr.

{"answer":"Yes. Buses link the villages along the route several times a day, which makes it easy to shorten a day or to get back to the start.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"Can you get around by bus?"}
Kommt man mit dem Bus voran?
Ja. Busse verbinden die Orte entlang der Route mehrmals am Tag. So lässt sich ein Tag verkürzen oder man kommt zum Start zurück.

{"answer":"Yes, between the main villages, booked through the Tanabe tourism office one day ahead.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"Is there a luggage transfer?"}
Ja, zwischen den größeren Orten, einen Tag vorher über das Tourismusbüro in Tanabe gebucht.
How much rain should I expect?
The Kii peninsula is one of the wettest regions of Japan. Waterproof boots and gaiters help less than you hope; a dry change of clothes in a sealed bag helps more.
Can you get around by bus?
Yes. Buses link the villages along the route several times a day, which makes it easy to shorten a day or to get back to the start.
Yes, between the main villages, booked through the Tanabe tourism office one day ahead.

Was man uns danach gefragt hat
帰ってから聞かれたこと
Do I need to book accommodation in advance?
Yes, and early. Takahara and Chikatsuyu each have a handful of minshuku, and in spring and autumn they are full months ahead. The Tanabe tourism office reservation service books in English.

{"answer":"Yes, and early. Takahara and Chikatsuyu each have a handful of minshuku, and in spring and autumn they are full months ahead. The Tanabe tourism office reservation service books in English.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"1","question":"Do I need to book accommodation in advance?"}
Muss ich die Unterkünfte im Voraus buchen?
Ja, und früh. Takahara und Chikatsuyu haben je eine Handvoll Minshuku, und im Frühling und Herbst sind sie Monate vorher voll. Der Reservierungsdienst des Tourismusbüros in Tanabe bucht auf Englisch.

{"answer":"Yes, and early. Takahara and Chikatsuyu each have a handful of minshuku, and in spring and autumn they are full months ahead. The Tanabe tourism office reservation service books in English.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"1","question":"Do I need to book accommodation in advance?"}
宿は事前に予約が必要ですか？
はい、早めに。高原と近露には民宿が数軒ずつしかなく、春と秋は数か月前に満室になります。田辺市観光協会の予約サービスは英語でも対応しています。

{"answer":"The Kii peninsula is one of the wettest regions of Japan. Waterproof boots and gaiters help less than you hope; a dry change of clothes in a sealed bag helps more.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"How much rain should I expect?"}
雨はどのくらい降りますか？
紀伊半島は日本でも特に雨の多い地域です。防水の靴やスパッツは思ったほど役に立たず、密封袋に入れた乾いた着替えのほうが助かります。

{"answer":"Yes. Buses link the villages along the route several times a day, which makes it easy to shorten a day or to get back to the start.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"Can you get around by bus?"}
バスで移動できますか？
はい。ルート沿いの集落を一日に何本かバスが結んでいるので、一日を短くしたり出発地へ戻ったりしやすいです。

{"answer":"Yes, between the main villages, booked through the Tanabe tourism office one day ahead.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"Is there a luggage transfer?"}
荷物の配送はありますか？
はい、主な集落の間で利用でき、前日までに田辺市観光協会で予約します。

{"answer":"The Kii peninsula is one of the wettest regions of Japan. Waterproof boots and gaiters help less than you hope; a dry change of clothes in a sealed bag helps more.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"How much rain should I expect?"}
Mit wie viel Regen muss man rechnen?
Die Kii-Halbinsel gehört zu den regenreichsten Gegenden Japans. Wasserdichte Schuhe und Gamaschen helfen weniger als erhofft; trockene Wechselkleidung in einem dichten Beutel hilft mehr.

{"answer":"Yes. Buses link the villages along the route several times a day, which makes it easy to shorten a day or to get back to the start.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"Can you get around by bus?"}
Kommt man mit dem Bus voran?
Ja. Busse verbinden die Orte entlang der Route mehrmals am Tag. So lässt sich ein Tag verkürzen oder man kommt zum Start zurück.

{"answer":"Yes, between the main villages, booked through the Tanabe tourism office one day ahead.","fieldname":"tx_kumanokodo_questions","hidden":"0","l10n_source":"0","open":"0","question":"Is there a luggage transfer?"}
Ja, zwischen den größeren Orten, einen Tag vorher über das Tourismusbüro in Tanabe gebucht.
How much rain should I expect?
The Kii peninsula is one of the wettest regions of Japan. Waterproof boots and gaiters help less than you hope; a dry change of clothes in a sealed bag helps more.
Can you get around by bus?
Yes. Buses link the villages along the route several times a day, which makes it easy to shorten a day or to get back to the start.
Yes, between the main villages, booked through the Tanabe tourism office one day ahead.

ルート沿いの集落は一日に何本かのバスで結ばれている。一日を短くしたり、本宮や那智から海沿いへ戻ったりするのに便利。

日本最古級の温泉のひとつで、本宮から少し歩いたところにある。狭い谷の沢沿いに湯屋が並ぶ。

4月の終わり、こどもの日を前に鯉のぼりが沢をまたいでいた。夕食の前に、木の屋根の下の露天風呂に浸かった。

A village along the river, halfway between Takijiri and Hongu. Most walkers sleep here after day two, and most minshuku stand along the river.

The lantern gate at the edge of the village is hard to miss. The middle lantern shows the three-legged crow, the messenger of the Kumano deities.
